$comment: <getopt.h> and <stdio.h> in one program (P68 round 11, D-LK-SYNTHESIZED-LIBRARY-BODY-DEFINED-STRONG-IN-EVERY-UNIT): the coordinator's seven-line repro of the round-close failure. On pe getopt is realized by a shipped runtime unit (runtime/platform/src/getopt.c, a nested single-member archive) that prints through fprintf, and the printf family is SYNTHESIZED on pe (the UCRT exports none of it), so the member and this program's CU each carried strong copies and the link failed with K_SymbolRedefinedAcrossUnits for printf, fprintf, sprintf, snprintf, sscanf and vfprintf — ✔MEASURED with main's dsscp at R11-F5, as was sqlite's testfixture link. Every synthesized body is now Weak + Hidden (the linker's all-weak arm keeps one copy per image; the body stays internal to its image). With no arguments getopt returns -1: prints `c=-1` (CRLF on pe, whose stdout is a text-mode stream; LF on ELF and Mach-O), exits 42. References: gcc 13.3.0 and clang 18.1.3 (x86_64), aarch64-linux-gnu-gcc 13.3.0 (qemu) and mingw-w64 13.2.0 run it to 42 (MSVC ships no <getopt.h>).
